steps.name: focused-gate6-integration
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=f1aafc2680482a52016596e9f6bb3502ce99c127; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; git reset --hard $EXPECTED >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; CXX=${CXX:-c++}; $CXX -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Isrc -Ilib/environment_control/src test/test_stage28d_rf_output_endpoint/test_main.cpp src/climate/Stage28dRfOutputEndpoint.cpp src/climate/Stage28dOutputBindings.cpp src/climate/ClimateSemanticOutput.cpp src/climate/rf433/ClimateRf433EndpointRegistry.cpp -o /tmp/stage28d_rf_output_endpoint_tests; /tmp/stage28d_rf_output_endpoint_tests; $CXX -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Isrc test/test_stage28d_thermal_sequence/test_main.cpp src/climate/Stage28dThermalTestSequence.cpp -o /tmp/stage28d_thermal_sequence_tests; /tmp/stage28d_thermal_sequence_tests; git diff --check; printf 'GATE6_INTEGRATION_FOCUSED_PASS commit=%s real_outputs=0 rf_tx=0\n' "$EXPECTED"

verify_steps.name: full-quality-gate
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=f1aafc2680482a52016596e9f6bb3502ce99c127; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; bash scripts/quality_gate_push.sh; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'GATE6_INTEGRATION_VERIFY_COMPLETE commit=%s real_outputs=0 rf_tx=0\n' "$EXPECTED"
